quote.text: In every walk with nature, one receives far more than he seeks.
quote.author: John Muir

fun_fact.text: Hungarian paprika isn't just one spice — there are eight official grades ranging from delicate and sweet to fiery hot! The town of Szeged and Kalocsa are so famous for paprika production that they host annual festivals celebrating this beloved red spice that's essential to dishes like goulash and chicken paprikash.

short_read.title: How Hummingbirds Hover in Place
short_read.teaser: These tiny acrobats can beat their wings up to 80 times per second and are the only birds that can fly backwards. Scientists have discovered the fascinating mechanics behind their incredible hovering ability.

medium_read.title: The Library of Alexandria: What Really Happened
medium_read.teaser: The ancient world's greatest library didn't burn down in one dramatic fire as many believe. The true story of how this treasure trove of knowledge was lost is more gradual and complex than legend suggests.

long_read.title: The Secret Lives of Orcas in the Pacific Northwest
long_read.teaser: The orcas of the Salish Sea have distinct cultures, languages, and family bonds that last a lifetime. This deep dive explores the Southern Resident killer whales that call the waters near Port Angeles home.

port_angeles.title: Black-Tailed Deer at Hurricane Ridge
port_angeles.description: August is a wonderful time to spot black-tailed deer grazing in the meadows at Hurricane Ridge, especially in the early morning or evening. These gentle creatures are native to the Olympic Peninsula and are often quite comfortable around visitors, making for delightful wildlife viewing opportunities just a short drive from Port Angeles.

puzzle_1.question: A hummingbird's heart beats approximately ___ times per minute.
puzzle_1.correct_response: That's right, Barbara! An amazing 1,200 beats per minute — their tiny hearts work incredibly hard!
puzzle_1.close_response: Very close! A hummingbird's heart actually beats about 1,200 times per minute — that's 20 times per second!
puzzle_1.wrong_response: A hummingbird's heart beats about 1,200 times per minute! That tiny heart works so hard to power their incredible hovering flight.
puzzle_1.learn_more_text: To support their high-energy lifestyle, hummingbirds must eat about half their body weight in sugar daily, visiting hundreds of flowers. Their metabolism is so fast that they enter a hibernation-like state called torpor at night to conserve energy.

puzzle_2.question: Which Hungarian word means 'hello' or 'goodbye'?
puzzle_2.correct_response: Szia! That's exactly right, Barbara! It's one of the most useful words — perfect for both coming and going.
puzzle_2.wrong_response: The answer is 'Szia' (pronounced SEE-ah)! It's the friendly, informal way to say both hello and goodbye in Hungarian.
puzzle_2.learn_more_text: Szia is the informal version used with friends and family, while 'Viszlát' is specifically goodbye. For more formal situations, Hungarians say 'Jó napot' (good day) for hello.

puzzle_3.question: What do orcas in the Pacific Northwest primarily use to communicate and navigate?
puzzle_3.correct_response: Perfect! Orcas use echolocation and a complex system of calls, whistles, and clicks — each pod even has its own unique dialect!
puzzle_3.wrong_response: It's echolocation and vocalizations! Each orca pod has its own unique dialect of calls, passed down through generations like a family language.
puzzle_3.learn_more_text: Scientists can identify individual orca pods just by listening to their calls. The Southern Resident orcas near Port Angeles have dialects so distinct that researchers call them 'acoustic clans' — they're truly speaking different languages!
